plainText:
Volume 22: Land, Sea and Sky is the twenty-second volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga. It is both the eighth and final volume in the and the first of five volumes in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

==Blurb==
As the battle between Legendary Pokémon Groudon and Kyogre rages on, so does the battle to control the orbs that control them. Then, when tragedy strikes, long hidden secrets are revealed, and Ruby comes to a profound realization.

Now, what role will Ruby's secret sixth Pokémon play in turning things around...?

==Publications==

Chapter 269: Return to Pallet Town

==Important events==
 
Courtney dies from being buried under a rockslide after being dragged into the Cave of Origin.
Norman and meet the same fate after quelling the titans due to the strain of controlling the powerful legends.
The reasons for Norman's banning from taking the Gym Leader test are revealed, as are many details regarding 's past history with him.
Maxie and Archie return and, after badly wounding Wallace by taking Winona hostage, are eventually defeated by the combined efforts of Ruby and .
is able to take back the Red and Blue Orbs and use its time travel powers to alter the course of events, reviving Courtney, Steven, and Norman.
Both Ruby and Sapphire are able to meet the deadline on their respective challenges and return to Littleroot Town, where Ruby's delayed birthday party is celebrated together with Sapphire's birthday.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
None

===Evolutions===
Ruby's "Feefee" evolves into in PS266.

===Other===
releases Celebi in PS267.

==Gym battles==
Sapphire defeats Norman in PS267.

==Pokémon Contests==
Ruby wins Master Rank Pokémon Contests in all categories in PS267.

==Trivia==
The last two chapters of this volume in the Chuang Yi release do not have official English titles. The names instead are translated Japanese names.
This issue has connecting cover art with the previous volume.
In the cover art, part of the white spike extending from Ruby's hat is not recolored to white from the Japanese release, even though the number 22 was moved.
